title: Martin Chilukwa v The Attorney General (2022/CCZ/0030) [2023] ZMCC 14 (10 March 2023)
case_name: Martin Chilukwa v The Attorney General
issue_tags: Public service values (Article 173) and qualification requirement (Article 259) require evidence
Employment/transfer/allowance disputes outside Constitutional Court jurisdiction
Burden of proof for alleging constitutional contravention.
outcome_detail: Challenge to DC appointments dismissed for lack of evidence and because employment-related claims lie outside Constitutional Court jurisdiction
